name: AR
description: World tracking over the device camera — ARKit on iOS, ARCore on Android, WebXR (immersive-ar over ARCore) in Chrome on Android, elsewhere on the web the camera under the scene turned by the sensors: planes, hit tests, anchors, image targets, QR-code targets (qr-anchor: its wasm in the WebXR arm, its C ABI on ARKit / ARCore), the estimated light. The app's side is ARScene.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera to place things in the room around you.
